descriptions.w3d_d25e_lazy_record_list_80200398: Lazily builds and caches an array of wrappers, one per 12-byte record of the info block from 0x80200460: stores the byte count at info+17 to *count, allocates count pointers with the global operator new[] (0x801fe220), and fills it with objects made by operator new(8) (0x801fe1d8) and 0x80200970. Returns the cached array at self+16.
